_doc: Canonical Arabic orthography rules for the ShiaCompanion zikr corpus. Source of truth for scripts/zikr_arabic/*.py and for the render-time map mirrored in lib/pages/zikr/zikr_content_parser.dart. See .claude/skills/zikr-arabic/SKILL.md.

source_normalization._doc: Applied to the stored text in Firestore. After this pass no codepoint outside `canonical_inventory` may appear in the corpus.

sequence._doc: Multi-char, applied first. Hamza-on-alef -> Indo-Pak bare alef carrying the same vowel.

lam_alif_marks._doc: Marks written AFTER the alif of a lam-alif belong before it: the vowel is the lam's, and the ligature repositions a trailing mark onto the wrong stroke. Applied as a reorder (see corpus.fix_lam_alif), not a string swap, because لاَّ must become لَّا with the shadda still on the lam. Reordered marks come out shadda-first, matching the corpus's dominant order (29,356 vs 299).

review_required._doc: Residue that needs a human decision, never auto-applied. Key = codepoint, value = why.
review_required.أ: bare hamza-alef with no vowel mark - the correct Indo-Pak vowel cannot be inferred mechanically
review_required.إ: bare hamza-alef with no vowel mark - same
review_required.ٴ: high hamza; appears in malformed clusters e.g. مَّرِیْٓٴًﺎ - inspect each occurrence

font_runtime._doc: Applied at render time by ZikrContentParser.formatArabicText. The per-font Indo-Pak substitution tables are gone: they existed only for MeQuran and Uthmani, both retired in favour of Scheherazade New, which draws every Indo-Pak letterform and both silah al-ha’ marks natively. What is left applies to every font.

common._doc: Typographic spaces no bundled font has ever had a glyph for, and the two silah al-ha’ marks Al Qalam encodes privately. Qalam maps U+E003/U+E004 and U+0656/U+0657 to the very same glyphs, so rewriting to the real codepoints is invisible in Qalam and is what lets any other font draw them.

font_runtime._end_of_ayah_doc: Fonts that draw the ayah medallion by enclosing the Arabic-Indic digits following U+06DD. A trailing "(N)" on an Arabic line becomes U+06DD plus those digits. Qalam is excluded: it draws its medallion from the ASCII parentheses the corpus is authored with, and renders U+06DD as an empty ornament that swallows the digits.
